full_judgment:
11. Prosecution case at the start and at the trial was that death was done to the victim upon torturing and by strangulation for non-payment of dowry. As against this, the stand of the condemned prisoner was that since the late afternoon of October 29, 1999 the victim was in a depressed mood and condemned prisoner's mother asked the victim to take snack in the evening but the victim did not take snack, that the condemned prisoner also called the victim to take snack in the evening but the victim refused to take snack and for that the condemned prisoner became angry with the victim, that at the time of dinner condemned prisoner's parents called the victim to have dinner with the members of the family of. the condemned prisoner but she did not attend the dinner and this caused serious anger to the condemned prisoner, that at about 23-30 hours of October 29, 1999 the condemned prisoner and the victim went to bed and before going to bed the condemned prisoner requested the victim to take food but she refused and the same made him angry seriously, that in the early dawn of October 30,1999 the condemned prisoner woke up and awoke the victim and asked her to take food but she refused, that the victim became angry and slapped the condemned prisoner and also pressed her neck, that said behaviour of the victim made the condemned prisoner furious, that the condemned prisoner tied the hands of the victim and sat on the chest of the victim and pushed cloth inside the mouth of the victim and wrapped the 'uma' around the neck of the victim and twisted the same and thereupon the victim became silent. 

 "(1) One oblique non continuous, most superficial ligature mark around the neck and also high up on the neck. Knot was found on the right side of the neck including on the right ear lobule (which on the upper part of the right side of the neck) no perchmentisation was found on the tissues of ligature mark. 

 38. Now let us see what Ripon stated in his confessional statement. On 9-11-1999 he made the statement. He stated that he tried to feed Mammi. She repeatedly refused to take any meal. He slapped her in anger. Being agitated, she caught hold of his neck. Blood rushed to his head Both of them were lying on the cot, side by side, When she caught held of his neck, climbing up over him, he pushed her away and climbed up and sat over her pressing her beneath and forcibly entered cloth into her mouth. He also caught hold of her neck by tying with a scarf  orna' found near. He then powerfully pulled the ends of the scarf for some time. Marnmi was groaning. At one time, he found Mamrni became defenceless. Her body became still. In the adjacent rooms, his parents, brothers, sister and maid were sleeping. After removal of the cloth from the mouth, her tongue came out a little. He tried to find pulse, but found none. He thought he killed his wife.
